description:
Tint is a company that enables SaaS platforms and marketplaces to unlock growth through embedded insurance. They are seeking a Marketing Associate to help grow their embedded insurance programs by owning campaigns that reach policyholders and drive growth across various sectors.

Build, launch, and optimize policyholder campaigns and lifecycle touchpoints - from welcome and activation through renewal and win-back - against our mapped lifecycle framework

Own the campaign loop end to end: partner with internal vertical and marketing leadership on the content calendar, draft emails and texts, create assets, build and send to targeted audiences, and report on results, including annualized premium generated

Carry direct revenue accountability, ensuring campaign performance translates into program growth across several growing embedded insurance programs

Monitor and improve evergreen and lifecycle touchpoints based on performance data, recommending changes to leadership and owning the implementation of those changes

Help expand policyholder marketing into new verticals launching in the coming months, working alongside marketing leadership, program managers, and product managers

Align with brand partners' marketing teams to coordinate co-marketing calendars so both sides' campaigns reinforce each other

Tailor brand marketing kits to each partner and support new partner launches across our embedded insurance programs

Draft and post company social media supporting policyholder events, product launches, and program milestones

Provide logistics support for partner-hosted events: swag, event documents, internal channels, and attendee updates (occasional travel may be required)

Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) fluently for drafting, asset creation, and campaign ideation — leveraging them to move faster and punch above your weight
job_summary: Tint is a company that enables SaaS platforms and marketplaces to unlock growth through embedded insurance. They are seeking a Marketing Associate to help grow their embedded insurance programs by owning campaigns that reach policyholders and drive growth across various sectors.

mustHave: 1–3 years of marketing experience, whether agency, in-house, or startup
Strong writing skills that let you draft clear, on-brand emails, texts, and campaign assets with minimal hand-holding
Comfort working in email and campaign platforms like HubSpot, or the drive to get there fast
The ability to read campaign results, draw conclusions, and adjust, and comfort being measured on outcomes like conversion and premium generated
The organizational ability to juggle campaigns across 4+ programs without losing the details
A collaborative communication style that works equally well with internal teams and external brand partners
Genuine excitement for hands-on, build-it-yourself work: you'd rather own something than manage a vendor
preferredHave: A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and can identify problems and come with ideas, not just questions
A comfort with ambiguity and a track record of figuring things out, even when the playbook doesn't exist yet
